what: Phase 1 of the estate go-live: the shared foundation (fall-kit/core) and two real estate organs — break-it (the ingest gateway) and konomi-slm (the verified pattern library) — running on it as nodes. Sealed before any foundation code or measuring code exists. The measurement takes no model judgment: core/prove.mjs computes the facts, core/judge.mjs (pure, gated) turns facts into verdicts, and CI re-runs both and demands the same receipt byte for byte.
scope: One machine. The nodes are separate objects in one process, and then separate operating-system processes that exchange nothing but bytes through a relay that holds no state and reads nothing. Cross-device meshing over WebRTC is Phase 3, not claimed here.

claims.claim: Every message between the two nodes is a signed LIGHT packet.
claims.measure: count of inter-node messages; count that do not begin with LGT1 and frame cleanly

claims.claim: Each node verifies the other before it parses: a packet with one byte changed, a packet signed by a key it never pinned, and a replayed packet are each refused before the body is decoded.
claims.measure: for each node, the three hostile packets: refusal stage and whether the decoder ran

claims.claim: The couplings follow evidence: when two peers offer the same skill and one returns answers whose receipts do not check, the asker's link to the honest peer grows and its link to the other shrinks, and later asks go to the honest one.
claims.measure: after a training run of asks, the two link weights, and where the next 20 asks are routed
claims.holds_if: honest link > dishonest link and at least 18 of the next 20 asks go to the honest peer

claims.claim: An attack refused by one node immunises the other, without ever teaching it to refuse a packet its own door would admit.
claims.measure: antigens shared; adopted by the receiver after re-running each on its own door; the same attack bytes at the receiver afterwards; a valid packet slipped into a bundle
claims.holds_if: adopted >= 1, the attack is recognised on sight at the receiver, the valid packet is not adopted (autoimmunity blocked >= 1), and no adopted antibody matches bytes the receiver's door admits

claims.claim: Every verified answer the asker uses is recorded as one signed contribution, and the two nodes' ledgers agree.
claims.measure: verified-and-used answers; value records written; credits on each ledger after reconcile; replay of each log
claims.holds_if: records = used answers, both ledgers give identical credits after reconcile, and replay re-derives both chains

claims.claim: A node's memory is kept in LIGHT and recalls by meaning.
claims.measure: the node's memory packed as a LIGHT vault, unpacked, compared; a recall for the triage question
claims.holds_if: byte-identical round trip and the top recalled record is the triage answer

claims.claim: A node cannot ask past its budget: the ask over the limit is refused before any packet exists.
claims.measure: a node with a budget of 5 asks; the sixth ask
claims.holds_if: the sixth is refused by the wallet and no sixth packet is built

claims.claim: The konomi-slm node grows from its seed: re-grown from the genome in its card, it has the same verified patterns.
claims.measure: pattern ids of the node as built, and of the node re-grown from its card's genome
claims.holds_if: the two id lists are identical and non-empty

claims.claim: Separate cells, same body: run as two operating-system processes that exchange only bytes through a relay, the nodes reach exactly the verdicts they reach in one process.
claims.measure: the verdict list of the in-process run and of the two-process run
